description: This Java source file defines a RESTful API resource for managing client identifiers within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting client identifiers, along with template retrieval for UI purposes. The class leverages Jakarta RESTful Web Services (JAX-RS) annotations, integrates with security and serialization services, and uses Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: ClientIdentifiersApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints for managing customer identifiers (e.g., documents like Passport, Drivers License) in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: retrieveAllClientIdentifiers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all identifiers for a specific client.

methods.name: newClientIdentifierDetails
methods.description: Provides a template for creating a new client identifier, including default values and allowed options.

methods.name: createClientIdentifier
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new identifier to a client, with duplicate checking.

methods.name: retrieveClientIdentifiers
methods.description: Retrieves a specific client identifier, with optional template fields.
